title: Newly Established Automotive Accessories Company Equity Stake For Sale in Chiba, Japan
tagline: Revenue comes from two streams: the sale of used automobile parts sourced in Japan and exported to the UAE, and vehicle and parts logistics in Japan, moving automobiles and spares from auction houses to port. We serve wholesalers, workshops and re-exporters, and work with auction houses / shipping lines / dismantling partners in Japan. The business is backed by a promoter with more than 27 years of experience in the automotive industry.
